name: CIC-IDS2017
description: Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity benchmark containing benign and common network attacks (DoS, DDoS, Brute Force, XSS, Botnet) over realistic network topologies.
schema_notes: Flow-based CSV exports (Destination Port, Flow Duration, Total Fwd Packets, SYN Flag Count, etc.).
fetch_note: Requires academic registration/click-through agreement on UNB server. Manual download & upload required.

name: CSE-CIC-IDS2018
description: Expanded AWS-based multi-scenario enterprise intrusion dataset featuring realistic enterprise traffic profiles and multi-vector botnet/bruteforce campaigns.
schema_notes: Flow-based CSV format with comprehensive bidirectional packet statistics.
fetch_note: Hosted via AWS/UNB portal requiring authentication/agreement. Manual download & upload required.

name: CICIoT2023
description: Large-scale IoT telemetry dataset capturing diverse IoT device profiles and 33 distinct attack types (DDoS, Recon, Spoofing, Mirai).
fetch_note: Large multi-gigabyte archive requiring manual acquisition.

name: UNSW-NB15
description: Cyber Range Lab dataset combining real normal activities and synthetic attack behaviors (Fuzzers, Analysis, Backdoors, DoS, Exploits).
schema_notes: Mixed flow and packet header features (proto, service, state, spkts, dpkts).
fetch_note: Hosted on UNSW server; manual download required.

name: CTU-13
description: Stratosphere Laboratory dataset containing 13 real botnet scenarios captured mixed with background enterprise traffic.
fetch_note: Direct public HTTP access available for sample NetFlow captures.

name: LANL Comprehensive Authentication
description: Los Alamos National Laboratory network event logs capturing Windows authentication events over 58 days.
schema_notes: Authentication logs (time, source user, destination user, authentication type).
fetch_note: Restricted government dataset requiring formal request.

name: DARPA Intrusion Detection Evaluation
description: Historical benchmark datasets (1998-1999 Lincoln Laboratory) simulating military network intrusions.
fetch_note: Legacy dataset archived for historical comparison.
